author: Animalogic
description:
Glyptodonts were built for civil war and grew larger, stronger, and until they got to the size of cars and met the first peoples to enter South America. But despite being so massive and interesting we knew surprisingly little about them until very recently, when have had a late career glow up. They went from being thought of as just the shells of ancient giant ground sloths, to being the rivals of sabertooth cats, to now owning their own branch of the armadillo family tree and being the greatest 'dillo of all time. It has been an amazing story of paleontological discovery. The is the story of the living armoured suburban-SUV that ruled south America.

author: Animalogic
description:
Nature's untitled project. The default mammal. The Potato-shaped wawa. These are just some of the names hyraxes get called every day. But we've been underestimating this little mammal. Their biology hides traits from a time when Africa was an isolated country. They're amazing singers. They're mentioned in ancient books as wise animals. And they're communal toilets are time machines that let us look at the environment thousands of years ago. So we're standing up for one of the must bullied and misunderstood animals in Africa: The hyrax.

Examining the nature of the beast.

From apex predators to the planet's strangest creatures, Animalogic goes deep into the science, behavior, and biology of the animal kingdom, one species at a time.
